title: Stage and Commit Changes to Git
trigger: User has made edits and wants to commit them to the git repository

steps.action: With a git repository open, the source control panel appears on the right side (Ctrl+B shows/hides it)
Under Staged Changes and Changes groups, review the list of modified (M), added (A), and deleted (D) files
Click a file name to see its diff in the panel, or click the control icon next to a file to stage or unstage it
Type a commit message in the Commit message field at the bottom of the panel
Click the Commit button to record the staged changes; the button is disabled until something is staged and a message is entered

outcome: Changes are staged, a commit message is entered, and the commit is recorded in git history
